summary: Part of the flood protection at {place} lies beneath a road that crews moved.
realLife: King County installed protective works underground along a realigned road on the Snoqualmie’s right bank.
gates: A county road project includes flood protection along its route.
weights: Unverified buried work increases the likelihood of an additional inspection.
inGame: needs: flood works installed alongside a county road.

turns.what: Crews build protection alongside the existing road.
turns.pulledBy: The road alignment cannot move within the right of way.
turns.writesBack: The final design records the surface barrier.

turns.what: The road opens after a second inspection.
turns.pulledBy: The first inspection leaves a buried component unverified.
turns.writesBack: The acceptance record gives the later inspection date.
